recentItems.title: Faces of China | A Tibetan coach returns home to grow young baseball talent
recentItems.description: Twenty-nine-year-old Tibetan Palden Penma grew up in a plateau county in northwest China's Qinghai. He once ventured away from home as a young, promising baseball player. But a few years ago, he made a resolute homecoming and became the coach of young baseball talents at home.

recentItems.title: Great Wall concert celebrates China-Pakistan friendship in Beijing
recentItems.description: Music and dance lit up the foot of the Great Wall as the 2026 Beijing Great Wall Concert opened this week. Featuring artists from China and Pakistan, the event blended symphonies and traditional melodies with artistic styles from the two countries.

recentItems.title: CIFTIS Vlog | First-person tour: check out Shougang Park
recentItems.description: Shougang Park, the permanent venue of CIFTIS, has a fresh new look. The 2026 CIFTIS takes place here from Sept. 9 to 13 and is open to visitors. Come along with our Xinhua correspondent to discover fun activities!

recentItems.title: WithChina | Kira Tikhonova: Dumplings and Hanfu bridge Chinese and Russian youth
recentItems.description: For a Russian student Kira Tikhonova, learning Chinese in Jilin is also a journey of cultural discovery. From making dumplings with Chinese classmates to wearing Hanfu and performing Tai Chi fan dance, she is building friendships and hopes to become a bridge between Chinese and Russian youth.

recentItems.title: Trendy China | Why Global Businesses Are Betting on China
recentItems.description:
Foreign businesses are betting on China - and for good reason. From green energy and EVs to healthcare and agriculture, they see profits to make, markets to capture and a future worth investing in.

At the 26th #CIFIT, the message was clear: China is where opportunity turns into growth.

recentItems.title: BRICS maximizes different voices for common challenges: Ethiopian expert
recentItems.description:
"The core idea behind BRICS is always #multilateralism."
As a venue for partnership, collaboration and dialogue formation, #BRICS maximizes different voices of member countries to work on common global challenges, Balew Demissie, Senior Consultant at Policy Studies Institute of #Ethiopia, told Xinhua in an interview.

recentItems.title: From market to innovation: Why U.S. companies continue to invest in China
recentItems.description: "Now they're coming here to learn and to innovate with Chinese companies because there's a lot of really dynamic innovation in China." A U.S. business leader said American companies in China are shifting from a focus on manufacturing and sales toward learning, innovation and co-creation with Chinese partners.#GLOBALink
